hooks.command: git fetch --prune --quiet 2>/dev/null; n=$(git rev-list --count main..origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); if [ "$n" = "0" ]; then echo '[session start] git fetch done: local main is up to date with origin.'; else echo "[session start] git fetch done: local main is $n commit(s) BEHIND origin/main. Pull main before reading or changing code."; fi; true
